title: God Makes a Covenant with Abram

verses.1: After these things the LORD spoke to Abram in a vision and said, "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield and your great reward."
verses.2: But Abram said, "Lord GOD, what can you give me? I still have no children, and the one who will inherit my household is Eliezer of Damascus."
verses.3: Abram continued, "You have not given me any children, so a servant born in my house will be my heir."
verses.4: Then the LORD spoke to him and said, "That servant will not be your heir. Your own son will be your heir."
verses.5: The LORD brought Abram outside and said, "Look up at the sky and count the stars if you are able to count them." Then He said, "That is how many descendants you will have."
verses.6: Abram believed the LORD, and the LORD counted that faith as righteousness.
verses.7: Then the LORD said to him, "I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land as your own."
verses.8: Abram asked, "Lord GOD, how can I know that this land will really be mine?"
verses.9: The LORD said to him, "Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
verses.10: Abram brought all of these animals, cut them in two, and placed each half across from the other. But he did not cut the birds in half.
verses.11: When birds of prey swooped down on the carcasses, Abram chased them away.
verses.12: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a dark and dreadful feeling came over him.
verses.13: Then the LORD said to Abram, "Know this for certain: your descendants will be strangers in a foreign land. They will be enslaved and mistreated there for four hundred years.
verses.14: But I will judge the nation that enslaves them, and afterward your descendants will come out with great wealth.
verses.15: As for you, you will die in peace and be buried at a good old age.
verses.16: Your descendants will return here in the fourth generation, because the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure."
verses.17: When the sun had fully set and it was dark, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the pieces.
verses.18: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram and said, "I am giving this land to your descendants, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates —
verses.19: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
verses.20: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
verses.21: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
